item: Sink sweep 6/n: the monitoring modules write a caught exception through record_text and record_traceback
summary: Every src/monitoring module that wrote exception_text or a raw traceback now goes through record_text or record_traceback: a database driver's exception, or a wrapper quoting one, is its class name only, and any other keeps its scrubbed words. The records guard now reads src/monitoring (secret_scrub aside) with a counted table of classifiers and non-records, each with its reason; the error journal still reads the traceback as raised for its two booleans (locked, interrupted) and stores only record_traceback's text. record_text withholds by class an exception whose text cannot be read, and llm bounded_error is scrubbed the same way. The reindex job says in a field of its own (pool_timeout) that the pool timed out, because a driver error keeps no words for the release run to find.
